title: 第1章 洞房花烛夜第2章 为仙子洗脚福报
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 觅仙城，蛮荒万里唯一古城。
夜空三轮明月渐隐，黎明天光划破苍穹。
风家护院已列阵晨练。
拳风呼啸，一声声大喝声中，数十斤石墩如星斗翻飞于周身。
西隅小院门开，沈云佝偻身形立于秋风，羡慕的注视着演武场上护院。
为首数人筋骨如大龙舒展，拳出如箭破风，脚落似雷撼地。
风家护院专属真修法门《滚石拳》。
修行第一境养体就是锤炼血气，蕴养体魄，场上时而有人气血透体，灿若烟霞。
神异中蕴含磅礴大力。
这等修行法，于蛮荒之地乃千金不换的仙缘。
纵使根基凡浊，也能修至养体九境，成万斤巨力，有机会拜入仙门圣宗，铸登仙之基。
风家外，多少人打破头都没机会习得修行法。
看着他们习练，沈云不自觉的跟着比划起来。
青衣圆帽，须发皆白，他俨然是风家一老仆。
演武场中央，身高八尺的护院总管瞧见沈云，咧嘴乐了。
“沈老头，昨儿刚娶了婆娘还起这么早打拳，不会洞房啥都没干吧。”
每月沈总管都有那么几天想练武，是个天赋根基差的武痴，他见怪不怪。
但这两天不一样啊！
“哈哈哈！”
“沈总管似乎六十有三，怕早就不行喽，跟练是想重振雄风吗？”
练武场上，一群护院习练中发出阵阵笑声。
年轻的护院看着沈云，眼中多少还蕴含着嫉妒。
昨日，大夫人赏赐沈老头一个二九年华的漂亮丫鬟。
那丫鬟是府内上上下下公认最美的女子，府中千金小姐，都比不得。
无数人魂牵梦绕。
凭什么？
凭老沈头是府内最大的老光棍！
还是凭他顺风尿湿鞋！
不知羡煞了多少护院、仆役。
笑声让沈云有些分神，脚下步子不稳，差点扭了老腰。
“一群目无尊长的小崽子，下月老子削你们开销！”
看到沈云似乎闪了老腰。
一个个护院也不敢笑了，扭头沉溺于练武中。
风家，若是寻常仆役敢如沈云这般光明正大的偷师，简直是找死。
不是所有仆人都有资格修行。
两年前一个杂役在假山中偷学被抓，四肢打断后不久就死了。
但沈云不一样。
身为账房总管，年轻也曾破格得授《滚石拳》。
只是没练出名堂。
沈云哆哆嗦嗦的扶着老腰，走到不远处石凳上坐下，这才缓了口气。
感受着身体的乏力，枯瘦的手摸着花白的胡须，沈云感慨万千。
“转眼已经六十三了！”
前世加班三天两夜的沈云，再一睁眼已经二十八。
当时他已经卖身到风府做家仆，还被打了一顿，意外真灵觉醒，明悟前世今生。
content_en:
Find Immortal City, the only ancient city in the wilderness.
The three bright moons in the night sky gradually disappeared, and the dawn light broke through the sky.
The Feng Family Nursing Home has formed a formation for morning exercises.
The fist wind roared, and with loud shouts, dozens of kilograms of stone pillars flew around him like stars.
The door of the small courtyard in the west corner opened, and Shen Yun's rickety figure stood in the autumn wind, admiringly watching the guardian of the courtyard on the martial arts field.
The muscles and bones of the first few stretched out like a big dragon, their punches cut through the wind like arrows, and their feet struck like thunder shaking the ground.
The Feng Family Nursing Home’s exclusive true cultivation method “Rolling Stone Fist”.
The first level of cultivation is to cultivate the body and strengthen the body. From time to time, there will be people on the field with blood flowing through the body, shining like smoke.
There is majestic power in the magic.
This kind of cultivation method is an immortal fate that cannot be exchanged for a lot of money in the wild land.
Even if your foundation is turbid, you can still cultivate to the ninth level of body cultivation, become powerful, and have the opportunity to join the Immortal Sect and build the foundation for becoming an immortal.
Outside the Feng family, many people broke their heads without having the chance to learn the practice.
Watching them practice, Chen Yun unconsciously started to follow the gestures.
Wearing a green robe and a round hat, with white beard and hair, he looks like an old servant of the Feng family.
In the middle of the martial arts arena, the eight-foot-tall nursing home manager grinned happily when he saw Shen Yun.
"Old man Shen, you just got married yesterday and you got up so early to do boxing. You can't do anything during the wedding."
Manager Shen wants to practice martial arts for a few days every month. He is a martial arts fanatic with poor talent. He is not surprised.
But these two days are different!
"Hahaha!"
"Mr. Shen seems to be in his late 60s, and I'm afraid he may have died a long time ago. Do you want to regain your glory by following him?"
On the martial arts training ground, a group of nurses burst into laughter while practicing.
The young nurse looked at Shen Yun with some jealousy in his eyes.
Yesterday, the eldest lady rewarded Old Shen with a beautiful maid in her twenties.
That maid is recognized by everyone in the house as the most beautiful woman, even the richest ladies in the house can't compare to her.
Countless people are haunted by dreams.
Why?
Old Shen is the biggest old bachelor in the house!
It's because he wets his shoes with the wind!
I don’t know how many nurses and servants I envied.
"Hiss~"
The laughter made Shen Yun a little distracted. His steps were unsteady and he almost twisted his waist.
"A bunch of disrespectful brats, I will cut your expenses next month!"
Seeing Shen Yun, he seemed to flash his back.
None of the nursing staff dared to laugh, and turned their heads to indulge in martial arts training.
In the Feng family, if an ordinary servant dared to steal a master like Chen Yun in an upright manner, he would be seeking death.
Not all servants are qualified to practice.
Two years ago, a handyman was caught stealing lessons in a rockery. His limbs were broken and he died soon after.
But Shen Yun was different.
As the account manager, he was also awarded the "Rolling Stone Boxing" in his youth.
It’s just that I didn’t become famous.
Chen Yun shivered, holding on to his old waist, walked to a stone bench not far away and sat down, and then he breathed a sigh of relief.
Feeling the fatigue in his body and touching his gray beard with his thin hands, Chen Yun was filled with emotions.
"It's already sixty-three in a blink of an eye!"
Shen Yun, who worked overtime for three days and two nights in his previous life, was already twenty-eight when he opened his eyes.
At that time, he had sold himself to work as a domestic servant in Feng Mansion and was beaten. Unexpectedly, his true spirit awakened and he understood his past and present lives.
